new_facts_from_search: No 2025-2026 NJ acquisition, sale or lease by Ambient Capital found in public sources; only NJ follow-on is the 2025-05 SIOR largest-industrial-transaction award to NAI Hanson's Perkins and Todd for the $156.3M deal (https://www.roi-nj.com/2025/05/09/real_estate_development/nai-james-e-hansons-perkins-and-todd-win-industrial-transaction-award/)

Firm's own site describes an IOS-only platform in 'strategic supply chain markets' with 'local execution, active asset management with a tenant focus'; contact page lists San Francisco as HQ, conflicting with press 'Chicago-based' (https://www.ambientcap.com/; https://www.ambientcap.com/contact)

Steve Azar, CFA (Principal & Co-Founder) is 'responsible for acquisitions, fundraising, and company operations' per NAIOP bio - likely acquisitions contact (https://www.naiop.org/about-us/bio-detail-page/?bio=e3f3e37e-4890-4525-aa1c-fd495bf787bf)

Ambient and LaSalle acquired a 74,533 SF multi-tenant truck terminal on 23.2 acres in Texas, listed as a 2025 transaction in Partners Real Estate's Texas IOS report (https://partnersrealestate.com/research/texas-ios/)

Byline Bank funded a $3.25M loan for a 2-acre IOS site in Ontario, CA bought by a JV of Ambient and an unnamed 'institutional equity partner' - shows small-check capability and JV structure (https://www.bylinebank.com/insights/byline-banks-commercial-real-estate-group-funds-3-25m-loan-for-acquisition-of-inland-empire-industrial-outdoor-storage-property/)

IOS List newsletter (single source) names the Harrison/Kearny seller as Aleman Trucking on a long-term absolute-NNN sale-leaseback; other outlets say seller undisclosed (https://news.ioslist.com/p/october-21-2024-ambient-buys-huge-new-jersey-ios-portfolio)

NAI Hanson buyer-side brokers on the NJ deal were Scott Perkins, Christopher Todd and William Ericksen (https://re-nj.com/harrison-kearny-industrial-outdoor-storage-portfolio-sells-for-156-million-nai-hanson-says/)
Matt Goode is Managing Partner and Head of Investments, 'responsible for sourcing new industrial acquisitions' - the acquisitions lead the pack lacked (https://www.ventureonere.com/team/matt-goode/)

Roy Splansky is a founding Principal covering acquisitions, dispositions, asset management and debt/equity (https://www.ventureonere.com/team/roy-splansky/); Ryan Stoller is Managing Partner - Development and sits on the Investment Committee (https://www.ventureonere.com/team/ryan-stoller/)

Most recent NJ buy: 150 Central Ave, Teterboro, 22,698 SF, 2025-07, via VK Industrial VII, a 'fully discretionary' fund targeting Chicago, Northeast and Florida industrial; 20' clear, 2 docks, 3 drive-ins (https://www.ventureonere.com/news/venture-one-fund-acquires-22698-square-foot-industrial-building-in-teterboro-new-jersey/)
VK Industrial VII is a 2024-vintage closed value-add real estate fund domiciled in Delaware; fund size not disclosed (https://pitchbook.com/profiles/fund/26394-94F)

No 2026 NJ acquisition found; VK Industrial VII's latest closings were a Queens NY low-coverage portfolio (2025-09) and a 122,601 SF Waukegan IL building (2026-04) (https://capdex.com/news/venture-one-acquires-122601-sf-multi-tenant-industrial)

25 Commerce Rd, Fairfield closed 2023-10 (press release dated 2023-10-16) via VK Industrial VI with three vacant units; price and seller not disclosed (https://www.ventureonere.com/news/venture-one-fund-acquires-103008-square-foot-industrial-building-in-fairfield-new-jersey/)

1 Dodge Dr, West Caldwell press release (2024-01-08) states 94,739 SF, 100% leased, bought by VK Industrial VI, LP from Terreno, which had paid $6.8M a decade earlier (https://www.ventureonere.com/news/venture-one-fund-acquires-94739-square-foot-industrial-building-in-west-caldwell-new-jersey/)
Property records show a 2026-02 deed on 1 Dodge Dr at $36M with party names obscured - a possible resale, unverified (https://njpropertyrecords.com/property/0721_1002_37)

North Brunswick asset is 1200 Airport Road, closed 2019-12 via VK Industrial V (https://www.ventureonere.com/news/venture-one-vk-fund-acquires-50993-sq-foot-building-in-north-brunswick-nj/); Totowa asset is 5 Taft Road, price not disclosed (https://rebusinessonline.com/venture-one-kovitz-acquire-67048-sf-industrial-building-in-totowa-new-jersey/)

Firm profile: industrial real estate PE fund manager, developer and operator in Chicago, the Northeast and Florida; Mark Goode described as founding Principal (https://gedc.com/business/venture-one-real-estate/)
